title.hr: Jedinice za duljinu, masu i volumen
title.en: Units of length, mass and volume

concept.hr: Jedinica je dogovorena količina; mjeriti znači brojiti koliko ih stane
concept.en: A unit is an agreed amount; measuring counts how many of it fit

summary.hr: Zumiraj ravnalo od kilometra do milimetra, važi utezima na vagi s dvije zdjelice, pretvaraj jedinice u tablici; najprije procijeni.
summary.en: Zoom a ruler from a kilometre to a millimetre, weigh with weights on a two-pan balance, convert units in the table; estimate first.

title.en: From a kilometre to a millimetre

concept.hr: Ravnalo koje se zumira: 1 km = 1000 m, 1 m = 10 dm, 1 dm = 10 cm, 1 cm = 10 mm
concept.en: A ruler that zooms: 1 km = 1000 m, 1 m = 10 dm, 1 dm = 10 cm, 1 cm = 10 mm

title.hr: Vaga s dvije zdjelice i utezi

concept.hr: Važemo utezima: 1 dag = 10 g, 1 kg = 100 dag
concept.en: Weighing with weights: 1 dag = 10 g, 1 kg = 100 dag

title.hr: Tablica mjernih jedinica: 3 m 4 dm = 34 dm
title.en: The table of units: 3 m 4 dm = 34 dm

concept.hr: Pretvaranje jedinica: znamenke ostaju u stupcima, čitamo do nove jedinice
concept.en: Converting units: the digits stay in their columns, read up to the new unit
